blocks.text: Capital1 endured yet another five-set marathon, overcoming a one-set deficit en route to a 20-25, 25-17, 22-25, 25-20, 15-8 triumph over winless Zus Coffee in the Siklab series of the 2026 Premier Volleyball League (PVL) All-Filipino Conference on Tuesday at the Mall of Asia Arena in Pasay City.
